title: Sealed needle-in-tube device moves 3-4 feet

tellings.quote: tube. Then I cranked up my power supply and that thing moved 3 4 feet in the air.

plain: A researcher named Charles Buer says that around 2016, in his lab, he sealed a needle inside a tube, turned up his power supply, and the device moved three to four feet into the air. He mentions a man named Andrew Arjima and says videos are posted on a website called Exodus. If true, it would point to a way of moving things without ordinary thrust, the kind of propulsion the episode calls antigravity.
